title: L1 reason code
description: Spec: CORPUS_DESIGN.md §3.3.1. One record per code in taxonomy.json#/codes. Codes are append-only (§2.3).

constructed.description: true where the code is our construction rather than a published platform taxonomy entry (CORPUS_DESIGN §3.4, Walmart).

plain_english.description: Seller-facing gloss. Nielsen heuristic #2. Never 'POA', never 'legal clause' (NAMING.md §5 invariant 2).

account_level.description: N9 — account-level codes only in v1. A listing-level code is out of scope, not a missing record.

observed.description: false = derived from published policy wording, not from a real notice. CORPUS_DESIGN §3.3.1 assumes observed strings; we do not have them yet and must not pretend we do.

governed_by.description: L2 clause ids. Every entry MUST resolve — gate G2.

appeal_pattern.description: Equals `code`. Exactly one L3 pattern per code — gate G3.

gap.description: A recorded hole in the corpus for this code. Present means: we know what is missing and why. Absent means we believe coverage is adequate — never means we did not look.
